Summary with extractive: The tuition and fees for full-time students at AIT without financial aid are outlined for various programs. The Doctorate program costs ฿1,495,800 for 7 semesters (84 credits) over 42 months, the Master’s (1 year) is ฿1,344,000 for 4 semesters (48 credits) over 22 months, the Master (2 years) is ฿855,600 for 4 semesters (48 credits) over 22 months, and the Certificate program is ฿524,800 for 1 semester (30 credits) over 5 months. Registration fees are ฿20,000 per semester, with tuition fees at ฿16,000 per credit. Language support fees are ฿2,000, medical insurance fees are ฿2,500 per year, student union fees are ฿150 per semester, and total fees vary by program. Living and accommodation expenses range from ฿11,500 to ฿15,000 per month, with additional visa fees of ฿1,900 per year. For the Faculty of Business Management, PhD programs cost ฿1,501,500 for 7 semesters (84 credits) over 42 months, DBA programs cost ฿1,516,100 for 3 years, MBA/MSc programs cost ฿632,700 for 1 year, and ฿856,600 for 2 years. Additional fees include medical insurance at ฿2,500 per year, student union fees at ฿150 per semester, and education visa fees at ฿1,900 per year. Payment can be made in Thai Baht through AIT's Current Account (SICOTHBK) or Savings Account (SICOTHBK) at Siam Commercial Bank. Exchange rates for THB to USD, USD to THB, THB to EUR, EUR to THB, THB to GBP, GBP to THB, THB to AUD, and AUD to THB are provided. Contact information includes admissions@ait.ac.th and aso@ait.asia for payment inquiries, with payment confirmation required via email to aso@ait.asia and prate ep@ait.asia with student ID or invoice number.
Summary with abstractive: AIT provides detailed tuition and fees for various programs, including Doctorate, Master’s, and Certificate courses, with costs ranging from ฿524,800 to ฿1,516,100. Students are advised to contact admissions@ait.ac.th for payment inquiries and to provide payment confirmation via email with the student ID or invoice number.

Summary with extractive: The AIT academic year consists of two semesters: January and August. The January Semester/Term Intake deadlines are: 20 December for overseas applicants requiring an educational visa, 15 February for overseas applicants requiring an educational visa in the March Term Intake (only for Faculty of Business Management), 25 February for other applicants in the March Term Intake, 15 May for overseas applicants requiring an educational visa in the June Term Intake (only for Faculty of Business Management), and 25 May for other applicants in the June Term Intake. The August Semester/Term Intake deadlines are: 28 February for HM King’s and Queen’s, and GMS scholarships, 31 March for other Scholarships (i.e. ADB-JSP, Bangchak: Master and Doctoral and others), 10 June for AIT Scholarships including RTG Fellowships, 30 June for overseas applicants requiring an educational visa, and 25 July for other applicants. The October Term Intake (only for Faculty of Business Management) deadlines are: 15 September for overseas applicants requiring an educational visa and 25 September for other applicants. The Admissions and Scholarships Unit can be contacted at P.O. Box 4, KlongLuang Pathumthani 1,2120 THAILAND, phone (662) 524 5024, and email admissions@ait.ac.th. Each program requires its own application for participation. The application process aims to get to know the student through their application, hear their voice, and explore their potential. The application process also helps the student get to know themselves better. AIT values the exceptional academic talent, intellectual curiosity, individual perspectives, creativity, and other defining attributes that each student uniquely contributes to the community. AIT provides students with distinctive opportunities to undertake their studies in rigorous and challenging ways. The application process is for students from a wide variety of backgrounds. The application process is for students who contribute a wide diversity of views, experiences, and perspectives.

AIT offers distinct educational opportunities through rigorous programs, with application deadlines varying by semester and program, and requires individual applications for each program.

Summary with extractive: Student housing at AIT offers various room types including air-conditioned/non-air-conditioned, cooking/non-cooking, and single/double occupancy. All rooms are fully furnished with regular maintenance services. Weekly cleaning service is available. Linens provision and laundry service (2 bedsheets, 2 towels, and 1 Pillowcase) is provided except for Category 2 (Dorm E, J, K) and SV Married Units. Special accommodation facilities for disabled individuals, including wheelchair users and those needing extra space for special equipment, are available (4 non-air-conditioned in Dorm C and 4 air-conditioned in Dorm X and Y).
Summary with abstractive: AIT provides diverse on-campus housing options with varying room types and facilities to accommodate different student needs. The housing services include maintenance, cleaning, and laundry support, with special provisions for disabled students.
